messages.subject: Browser tab name
parts: Is there a way to give the browser a custom tab name for our app?  For example, mine is the html header code rather than the name of our project.  I imagine this is something super simple that I just don't understand yet!  Thanks in advance.  :)

messages.author: 85bbec2b2853688f
messages.subject: Re: Browser tab name
parts:
You should be able to include a "title=MyPage" argument in your shiny page layout or include a titlePanel. 

See more here:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/layout-guide.html
http://shiny.rstudio.com/reference/shiny/latest/navbarPage.html

On Monday, August 18, 2014 1:53:49 PM UTC-4, Barb Banbury wrote:
Is there a way to give the browser a custom tab name for our app?  For example, mine is the html header code rather than the name of our project.  I imagine this is something super simple that I just don't understand yet!  Thanks in advance.  :)

messages.author: 4ff0cd0800ebb0b6
messages.subject: Re: Browser tab name
parts:
Thanks for the response.  Turns out, I was over thinking it and it is an argument to headerPanel.  I should read the help pages more frequently.  

  headerPanel(

    title=HTML(paste("shiny", tags$span(style="color:#BF00FF", "Phrynomics"), sep = "")), windowTitle = "BACON"), 

...
